category.quote: The subscriber will receive a minimum assured pension of ₹ 3,000/- per month after attaining the age of 60 years.

age.quote: The applicant should be between 18 and 40 years of age at the time of entry.

occupation.quote: The applicant should be a Small or Marginal Farmer.

gate_notes: Requires cultivable landholding up to 2 hectares and name in land records as on 01.08.2019
Requires Aadhaar card and savings bank account or PM-KISAN account
Excludes SMFs covered under NPS, Employees State Insurance Corporation scheme, Employees Fund Organization Scheme, Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan Yojana and Pradhan Mantri Vyapari Maandhan

Excludes institutional landholders, constitutional post holders, Ministers/MPs/MLAs/Mayors/District Panchayat Chairpersons, serving/retired government employees excluding MTS/Class IV/Group D, income tax payers, and practising professionals like Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, Chartered Accountants, Architects
